name: Panel UI
summary: Accessible React Native/Expo UI on Tailwind (Uniwind) and Reanimated; npm or CLI copy.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 136 documented component modules.
Primary runtime is React Native / Expo (not web React); iframe demos are the Next.js docs site.
CLI copy-paste via panelui-cli also supported; registry at panelui.dev/r/{name}.json.
iframe demos only; no Expo Go / device smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pressable action with variants, sizes, loading state and icon slots.

demo.peerNotes: Expo SDK 57+ / React Native. npm panelui-native or CLI copy-paste via panelui-cli. Uniwind + Reanimated peers.

components.copyCode:
npx expo install panelui-native
# or copy source: npx panelui-cli@latest init && npx panelui-cli@latest add button

import { Button } from "panelui-native"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use PanelUI free MIT React Native/Expo component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://panelui.dev/docs/components/button. Install with `npx expo install panelui-native` (plus Uniwind/Reanimated peers per https://panelui.dev/docs/installation) or copy source with `npx panelui-cli@latest add button`. Registry item: https://panelui.dev/r/button.json. Home: https://panelui.dev. Docs: https://panelui.dev/docs. Repo: https://github.com/panel-ui/PanelUI. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/panel-ui/PanelUI/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Khalid Abdi). Pricing free. Primary target is Expo / React Native (not web React).
